SECTION 1.1 · 教材 p.1SECTION 1.1 · Textbook p.1

复数Complex numbers

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

极形式、乘方与开方Polar form, powers, and roots

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

复数也能画成一支箭头。先找箭头有多长、朝哪里，再处理乘方和开方；角度会决定有几个不同的根。

Think of a complex number as an arrow. Find its length and direction first; powers and roots then become operations on lengths and angles.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

复数的模表示长度，辐角表示方向。乘法把长度相乘、角度相加；开 n 次方会出现 n 个等间隔根。

The modulus of a complex number is its distance from the origin. Its argument is its direction angle. Multiplication multiplies distances and adds angles. Taking an nth root gives n equally spaced roots.

z=reiθ,z1/n=r1/nei(θ+2kπ)/n
使用条件When it applies

z≠0；k=0,…,n−1。主辐角约定为 (−π,π]。

z≠0; k=0,…,n−1. We use (−π,π] as the range of the principal argument.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

先把非零复数写成 z=r(cosθ+isinθ)=reiθ。

这里 r=|z|>0 是长度，θ 是方向；同一方向加上 2kπ 仍表示同一点。

两个极形式相乘时，r1eiθ1r2eiθ2=r1r2ei(θ1+θ2)。

所以长度相乘、角度相加；连乘 n 次就得到 wn=sneinϕ。

若要解 wn=z，分别比较长度和方向：sn=r，nϕ=θ+2kπ。

因此 s=r1/n、ϕ=(θ+2kπ)/n，不能只保留一个角。

取 k=0,1,…,n−1，相邻角相差 2π/n，给出 n 个互异根；把 k 再加 n 只会多转一整圈，重复原来的根。

零复数需另说：它没有辐角，但方程 wn=0 只有根0。

Write a nonzero complex number as z=r(cosθ+isinθ)=reiθ.

Here r=|z|>0 is its length and θ its direction.

Adding 2kπ to the direction represents the same point.

Multiplication gives r1eiθ1r2eiθ2=r1r2ei(θ1+θ2).

Thus lengths multiply and angles add.

Repeating this n times gives wn=sneinϕ.

To solve wn=z, compare lengths and directions separately: sn=r and nϕ=θ+2kπ.

Hence s=r1/n and ϕ=(θ+2kπ)/n.

Keeping only one angle would omit roots.

Taking k=0,1,…,n−1 gives n distinct roots separated by 2π/n.

Increasing k by n adds one full turn and repeats a root.

Zero is separate: it has no argument, but wn=0 has only the root zero.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

求方程 z3=8i 的全部复数根。

Find every complex root of z3=8i.

已知什么Given

z 是待求复数，i 是虚数单位。右端 8i 的模为 8、辐角为 π/2 加整圈。

z is the unknown complex number, and i is the imaginary unit. The modulus of 8i is 8, and its argument is π/2 plus whole turns.

要求什么Find

找出三个互不相同的根，并写成直角坐标形式。

Find the three distinct roots and write them in Cartesian form.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1把右端写成极形式Write the right side in polar form
    为什么这样做Why this step

    复数乘方会把模乘方、把辐角相乘，所以先改写右端。

    A complex power raises the modulus and multiplies the argument, so first rewrite the right side.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    8i=8ei(π/2+2kπ)，其中 k∈Z 表示任意整圈。

    8i=8ei(π/2+2kπ), where k∈Z represents any whole number of turns.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2设未知数的极形式Give the unknown a polar form
    为什么这样做Why this step

    这样可以分别比较等式两边的模和辐角。

    This lets us compare the moduli and arguments separately.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    令 z=reiθ，其中 r≥0 是模、θ 是辐角，则 z3=r3ei3θ。

    Let z=reiθ, where r≥0 is the modulus and θ is an argument; then z3=r3ei3θ.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3分别解模和辐角Solve for modulus and argument
    为什么这样做Why this step

    两个非零复数相等时，模相等，辐角相差整圈。

    Equal nonzero complex numbers have equal moduli and arguments differing by whole turns.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    由 r3=8 得 r=2；由 3θ=π/2+2kπ 得 θ=π/6+2kπ/3。

    From r3=8, obtain r=2; from 3θ=π/2+2kπ, obtain θ=π/6+2kπ/3.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4列出三个不同的根List the three distinct roots
    为什么这样做Why this step

    辐角每增加 2π/3 得到一个新根，三个以后开始重复。

    Each increase of 2π/3 gives a new root, and the values repeat after three roots.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    取 k=0,1,2，得到 z=2eiπ/6=3+i、z=2e5iπ/6=−3+i、z=2e3iπ/2=−2i。

    For k=0,1,2, the roots are z=2eiπ/6=3+i, z=2e5iπ/6=−3+i, and z=2e3iπ/2=−2i.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 三个根的模都是 2，立方后的模都是 23=8。

    All three roots have modulus 2, so their cubes have modulus 23=8.

  • 三个辐角乘以 3 后都与 π/2 相差 2π 的整数倍。

    Multiplying each argument by 3 gives π/2 plus an integer multiple of 2π.

  • 直接代入第三个根可得 (−2i)3=8i。

    Direct substitution of the third root gives (−2i)3=8i.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

求方程 w3=−27 的全部复数根。用极形式列出三个根，再写成实部加虚部的形式。

Find all complex roots of w3=−27. List three roots in polar form, then write each in real-plus-imaginary form.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

负实数的长度是正数；先写 −27=27eiπ。

A negative real number still has positive magnitude: start with −27=27eiπ.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

设 w=seiϕ，比较得到 s3=27 和 3ϕ=π+2kπ。

Write w=seiϕ and compare: s3=27 and 3ϕ=π+2kπ.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

只需取 k=0,1,2；三个角是 π/3,π,5π/3。

Use k=0,1,2 only; the three angles are π/3,π,5π/3.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    首先取长度：|w|3=27，所以 |w|=3。

    First compare magnitudes: |w|3=27, so |w|=3.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    负号属于角度，不属于长度。

    The minus sign belongs to the angle, not the magnitude.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    方向需满足 3ϕ=π+2kπ，因此 wk=3ei(π+2kπ)/3。

    The direction must satisfy 3ϕ=π+2kπ, giving wk=3ei(π+2kπ)/3.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    取 k=0,1,2 就得到三个互异根，继续取值只会重复。

    Choosing k=0,1,2 gives three distinct roots; further values repeat them.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    代入三角函数得 w0=3/2+(33/2)i、w1=−3、w2=3/2−(33/2)i。

    Evaluate the trigonometric functions to obtain w0=3/2+(33/2)i, w1=−3, and w2=3/2−(33/2)i.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    每个根的角乘三后都是奇数倍的圆周半圈，因此立方都为负实数。

    Tripling any of their angles gives an odd number of half-turns, so every cube is negative real.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

检查 (−3)3=−27，另两根互为共轭且模均为3。常见错误：只写实根；三次方程在复数中应列出三个根。

Check (−3)3=−27; the other two roots are conjugates with magnitude 3. A common error is giving only the real root: list all three complex roots.

记忆线索Memory cue

乘除用极式，求实虚部用代数式；求根记得分支。

Use polar form for multiplication and division. Use Cartesian form to find real and imaginary parts. List every branch when finding roots.

SECTION 1.2 · 教材 p.8SECTION 1.2 · Textbook p.8

复变函数与分支Complex functions and branches

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

平方根支点与黎曼面Square-root branch points and Riemann surfaces

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

沿着原点绕一圈，平方根可能变成原来的负数。先说明你在哪个区域、选哪一支，函数值才有唯一含义。

Going once around the origin can reverse the sign of a square root. Specify the region and the chosen branch before calculating a value.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

绕一个零点一周后函数值改变，说明这里是支点。对平方根，奇数阶零点或极点会使符号翻转；切开平面后可选单值分支，再将两张割面交叉粘合。

A point is a branch point if going once around it changes the function value. For a square root, a zero or pole of odd order reverses the sign. Cuts let us choose a single-valued branch. Two cut copies of the plane can then be joined crosswise.

(z−a)m⟼emπi(z−a)m
使用条件When it applies

在局部非零解析因子已选单值根时使用；无穷远需令 w=1/z 检查。

Use this argument after choosing a single-valued root of the locally nonzero analytic factor. At infinity, substitute w=1/z and check the point at zero.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

在候选点 a 附近，把根号内部写成 (z−a)mh(z)，其中 h(a)≠0，m 是整数。

取足够小的邻域，让 h 无零点并选定一个解析平方根，可能变值的部分就只剩 (z−a)m/2。

写 z−a=ρeiθ。

沿绕 a 一周的路径连续跟踪时，角度从 θ 增加到 θ+2π，所以 (z−a)m/2 乘以 eimπ=(−1)m。

m 为奇数时值变成相反数，一圈后没有回到原值，所以是平方根支点；m 为偶数时不翻号，这个局部幂因子不产生支点。

负整数也适用，因此奇数阶极点同样要检查。

无穷远的绕圈需先换 w=1/z，再检查 w=0。

割线的作用是阻止在单张平面内绕单个支点一圈；平方根的两张割面交叉粘合后，跨割线就换叶，两圈才回原叶。

Near a candidate point a, write the radicand as (z−a)mh(z), where h(a)≠0 and m is an integer.

In a sufficiently small neighborhood, choose an analytic square root of the nonvanishing factor h.

Only (z−a)m/2 can change value after continuation.

Write z−a=ρeiθ.

Continuous tracking once around a changes the angle from θ to θ+2π, multiplying (z−a)m/2 by eimπ=(−1)m.

An odd m reverses the sign, so one circuit does not return to the initial value: this is a square-root branch point.

An even m does not reverse the sign, so that local power introduces no branch point.

Negative integers work too, so poles of odd order must also be checked.

To check infinity, first use w=1/z and inspect w=0.

A cut prevents a loop around a single branch point within one sheet.

Cross-gluing two cut sheets makes a cut crossing switch sheets; two circuits return to the initial sheet.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

z2−1 在哪些点有支点？无穷远是不是支点？

Where are the branch points of z2−1, and is infinity a branch point?

已知什么Given

z 是复变量。绕支点一圈后，选定的函数值不能回到原值。

z is a complex variable. After one circuit around a branch point, a chosen value cannot return to itself.

要求什么Find

找出有限支点，并单独判断无穷远。

Find the finite branch points and test infinity separately.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1分解根号内的式子Factor the expression under the root
    为什么这样做Why this step

    平方根在奇数阶零点附近会出现半整数次幂。

    A square root develops a half-integer power near a zero of odd order.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    z2−1=(z−1)(z+1)，所以根号内在 z=1 和 z=−1 处各有一个一阶零点。

    z2−1=(z−1)(z+1), so the expression under the root has simple zeros at z=1 and z=−1.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2检查两个有限零点Test the two finite zeros
    为什么这样做Why this step

    局部的一次因子开平方后会在绕行一圈时变号。

    The square root of a local linear factor changes sign after one circuit.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    在 z=1 附近，函数含 (z−1)1/2；在 z=−1 附近，函数含 (z+1)1/2，因此有限支点是 z=±1。

    Near z=1, the function contains (z−1)1/2; near z=−1, it contains (z+1)1/2, so the finite branch points are z=±1.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3把无穷远移到原点Move infinity to the origin
    为什么这样做Why this step

    令倒数变量趋于零，就能用普通局部分析判断无穷远。

    Making a reciprocal variable tend to zero turns the test at infinity into an ordinary local test.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    令 w=1/z，则 z2−1=w−11−w2；无穷远对应 w=0。

    Let w=1/z; then z2−1=w−11−w2, and infinity corresponds to w=0.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4判断无穷远Decide what happens at infinity
    为什么这样做Why this step

    整数次幂绕一圈不变号，解析且非零的根号也可固定一个分支。

    An integer power does not change sign after a circuit, and the nonzero square root can use one analytic branch.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    在 w=0 附近，1−w2 可取解析分支，而 w−1 是整数次幂，所以无穷远不是支点。

    Near w=0, choose an analytic branch of 1−w2; since w−1 is an integer power, infinity is not a branch point.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 绕 z=1 或 z=−1 一圈时，相应平方根因子变号。

    A circuit around z=1 or z=−1 changes the sign of the corresponding square-root factor.

  • 绕 w=0 一圈时，w−1 回到原值，因此无穷远没有分支交换。

    A circuit around w=0 returns w−1 to its original value, so no sheets exchange at infinity.

  • 可沿 [−1,1] 取割线，把两个有限支点连接起来。

    A valid branch cut is [−1,1], which joins the two finite branch points.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

对多值函数 F(z)=(z−2)2(z+1)，判断 z=2、z=−1 和无穷远点是否为支点。支点按沿小闭路连续跟踪一圈后是否变值来判断。

For the multivalued function F(z)=(z−2)2(z+1), decide whether z=2, z=−1, and infinity are branch points. Track a value continuously around one small closed loop.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

看根号内部零点或极点的阶数：平方根遇奇数阶才翻号。

Inspect the order of a zero or pole inside the square root: an odd order reverses the sign.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

在 z=2 附近是二阶零点；在 z=−1 附近是一阶零点。

Near z=2 the zero has order two; near z=−1 it has order one.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

无穷远改令 w=1/z，根号内部变为 w−3(1−2w)2(1+w)。

At infinity put w=1/z; the expression inside the root becomes w−3(1−2w)2(1+w).

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    在 z=2 附近，因子 z+1 不为零，可以局部选一个解析平方根。

    Near z=2, the factor z+1 is nonzero and has a locally analytic square root.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    于是 F(z)=(z−2)z+1；绕一圈时整数幂不变，所以这里不是支点。

    Thus F(z)=(z−2)z+1; an integer power returns to its original value after one loop, so this is not a branch point.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    在 z=−1 附近，因子 (z−2)2 非零，而 z+1 绕一圈会乘以 eiπ=−1。

    Near z=−1, the factor (z−2)2 is nonzero, while z+1 acquires the factor eiπ=−1 after one loop.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    因此这里是支点。

    This point is therefore a branch point.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    对无穷远令 w=1/z。

    At infinity set w=1/z.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    根号内部是 w−3(1−2w)2(1+w)；后两个因子在原点附近非零，可能变值的是 w−3/2。

    Inside the root we obtain w−3(1−2w)2(1+w); the last two factors are nonzero near the origin, leaving w−3/2 as the possible source of multiple values.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    绕一圈乘以 e−3πi=−1，因此无穷远也是支点。

    A loop multiplies it by e−3πi=−1, so infinity is also a branch point.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

答案：只有 z=−1 和无穷远是支点。不要把所有根号零点都判为支点；偶数阶零点 z=2 不翻号。

Answer: only z=−1 and infinity are branch points. A zero inside a square root need not be a branch point: the even-order zero z=2 does not reverse the sign.

记忆线索Memory cue

支点看绕圈是否变值，不能把每个奇点都叫支点。

A branch point is detected by a change after a circuit. A singular point is not automatically a branch point.

SECTION 1.3 · 教材 p.13SECTION 1.3 · Textbook p.13

微分与解析函数Differentiation and analytic functions

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

柯西–黎曼条件与调和共轭Cauchy–Riemann equations and harmonic conjugates

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

实变量求导只沿一条直线，复变量求导却允许从任何方向靠近。先拆出实部和虚部，用两个偏导关系筛选候选点，再检查是否真的可导。

A complex derivative must agree along every approach direction. Split the function into real and imaginary parts, use two partial-derivative relations to find candidates, then check differentiability.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

复导数要求从任意方向逼近都得到同一值，比实函数可微更强。先分出 u,v，再检查两条 C–R 方程。解析要求在一个开邻域内处处可导。

A complex derivative must have the same limit from every direction. This is stronger than real differentiability. First separate u,v, then check both C–R equations. Analyticity means differentiability throughout an open neighborhood.

ux=vy,uy=−vx,f′=ux+ivx
使用条件When it applies

偏导在邻域连续时，C–R 条件对可导充分；只在一个点成立不等于在邻域解析。

When the partial derivatives are continuous in a neighborhood, the C–R equations are sufficient for complex differentiability. Holding at one point does not establish analyticity in a neighborhood.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

复导数必须沿所有方向得到同一极限。

先沿实方向取增量 h，由实偏导得到 [f(z+h)−f(z)]/h→ux+ivx。

再沿虚方向取增量 ih，得到 [f(z+ih)−f(z)]/(ih)→vy−iuy。

两方向若不同，复导数就不存在；比较实虚部，必要条件是 ux=vy,uy=−vx。

反过来，若偏导在邻域连续，实二元可微性给 Δf=(ux+ivx)Δx+(uy+ivy)Δy+o(|Δz|)。

C–R 使 uy+ivy=i(ux+ivx)，所以前两项合并为 (ux+ivx)Δz。

除以任意非零增量 Δz 后，余项趋零，因此复导数存在且等于 ux+ivx。

只在某一点成立仅能在上述充分条件下说明该点可导；解析还要求某个开邻域内每一点都可导。

A complex derivative must have the same limit from every direction.

A real increment h gives [f(z+h)−f(z)]/h→ux+ivx through real partial derivatives.

An imaginary increment ih gives [f(z+ih)−f(z)]/(ih)→vy−iuy.

Different directional limits rule out a complex derivative.

Equating real and imaginary parts gives the necessary conditions ux=vy,uy=−vx.

Conversely, continuous partial derivatives in a neighborhood give real differentiability: Δf=(ux+ivx)Δx+(uy+ivy)Δy+o(|Δz|).

C–R gives uy+ivy=i(ux+ivx), combining the first two terms into (ux+ivx)Δz.

Dividing by any nonzero increment Δz makes the remainder vanish, giving the derivative ux+ivx.

Equations at just one point yield pointwise differentiability only under the stated sufficient regularity; analyticity requires differentiability throughout an open neighborhood.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

已知解析函数 f(z)=u(x,y)+iv(x,y) 的实部为 u=x2−y2，且 f(0)=0，求 f(z)。

An analytic function f(z)=u(x,y)+iv(x,y) has real part u=x2−y2 and satisfies f(0)=0; find f(z).

已知什么Given

z=x+iy，u 和 v 分别是实部与虚部。解析函数满足 ux=vy 和 uy=−vx。

z=x+iy, and u and v are the real and imaginary parts. An analytic function satisfies ux=vy and uy=−vx.

要求什么Find

先求调和共轭 v，再把结果写成 z 的函数。

Find the harmonic conjugate v, then write the result as a function of z.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1求实部的偏导Differentiate the real part
    为什么这样做Why this step

    柯西–黎曼方程把已知的 u 与未知的 v 联系起来。

    The Cauchy–Riemann equations connect the known function u to the unknown function v.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    由 u=x2−y2 得 ux=2x、uy=−2y。

    From u=x2−y2, obtain ux=2x and uy=−2y.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2用第一条方程积分Integrate the first equation
    为什么这样做Why this step

    由 vy=ux 可以先沿 y 方向恢复 v。

    The equation vy=ux lets us integrate first in the y direction and recover v.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    vy=2x，对 y 积分得 v=2xy+g(x)；g(x) 是积分时可能漏下的任意函数。

    vy=2x, so integration with respect to y gives v=2xy+g(x); g(x) is the arbitrary function left by the integration.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3用第二条方程定函数Use the second equation
    为什么这样做Why this step

    另一条柯西–黎曼方程会消除多余的 g(x)。

    The other Cauchy–Riemann equation removes the extra freedom in g(x).

    具体怎么算Calculation

    vx=2y+g′(x)=−uy=2y，所以 g′(x)=0，即 g(x)=C。

    vx=2y+g′(x)=−uy=2y, so g′(x)=0 and hence g(x)=C.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4使用初值并合并Apply the initial value and combine
    为什么这样做Why this step

    初值决定最后的实常数 C。

    The initial value determines the remaining real constant C.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    由 f(0)=0 得 C=0，于是 f=x2−y2+i(2xy)=(x+iy)2=z2。

    From f(0)=0, obtain C=0; therefore f=x2−y2+i(2xy)=(x+iy)2=z2.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 结果 f=z2 的实部确实是 x2−y2。

    The real part of f=z2 is exactly x2−y2.

  • 把 z=0 代入得到 f(0)=0。

    Substitution of z=0 gives f(0)=0.

  • 所得 v=2xy 满足 vy=2x=ux 和 vx=2y=−uy。

    The result v=2xy satisfies vy=2x=ux and vx=2y=−uy.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

设 f=u+iv 在整个复平面解析，实部 u(x,y)=x2−y2+2x，且 f(0)=i。求 v(x,y) 和 f(z)。

Let f=u+iv be analytic on the entire complex plane, with real part u(x,y)=x2−y2+2x and f(0)=i. Find v(x,y) and f(z).

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

先求 ux 和 uy，再用 vy=ux、vx=−uy。

Find ux and uy, then use vy=ux and vx=−uy.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

由 vy=2x+2，关于 y 积分得到 v=(2x+2)y+g(x)。

From vy=2x+2, integration with respect to y gives v=(2x+2)y+g(x).

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

另一条方程给 g′(x)=0，初值再定这个实常数。

The other equation gives g′(x)=0; use the initial value to determine this real constant.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    求偏导得 ux=2x+2、uy=−2y。

    Differentiate to obtain ux=2x+2 and uy=−2y.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    两条 C–R 方程因此要求 vy=2x+2、vx=2y。

    The two C–R equations require vy=2x+2 and vx=2y.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    先对第一条关于 y 积分：v=2xy+2y+g(x)。

    Integrate the first equation with respect to y: v=2xy+2y+g(x).

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    此时“积分常数”可以依赖另一个变量，不能直接删掉。

    The integration constant may depend on the other variable, so keep it.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    再对所得式关于 x 求导，得到 vx=2y+g′(x)。

    Differentiate this expression with respect to x to get vx=2y+g′(x).

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    与第二条比较可知 g′(x)=0，所以 g=C。

    Comparing with the second equation yields g′(x)=0, hence g=C.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    初值说明 v(0,0)=1，故 C=1。

    The initial value says v(0,0)=1, so C=1.

  8. 第 8 步Step 8

    答案为 v=2xy+2y+1 和 f(z)=z2+2z+i。

    The answers are v=2xy+2y+1 and f(z)=z2+2z+i.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

把 z=x+iy 代入答案检查实部，再检查 f(0)=i。常见错误是忘记虚部的常数1。

Substitute z=x+iy into the answer to check its real part, then check f(0)=i. A common error is omitting the constant 1 in the imaginary part.

记忆线索Memory cue

先验调和，再用 C–R 积分，最后用初值定常数。

Check that the given part is harmonic. Integrate C–R to find the other part. Use the initial value to fix the constant.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

调和函数与正交曲线Harmonic functions and orthogonal curves

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

调和函数描述没有内部热源的稳定温度一类的场。把两个方向的二阶偏导相加，就能先检查题目是否属于这一类。

A harmonic function models a steady field with no interior source. Add its second partial derivatives to check whether a proposed function is harmonic.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

解析函数的实部与虚部都是调和函数；在导数非零的点，等实部与等虚部曲线垂直。

The real and imaginary parts of an analytic function are harmonic. Where its derivative is nonzero, the curves of constant real part and constant imaginary part meet at right angles.

Δu=Δv=0,∇u·∇v=0
使用条件When it applies

局部解析；讨论曲线切线时还要求 f′(z0)≠0。

The function is locally analytic. To discuss the curve tangents, also require f′(z0)≠0.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

从 C–R 的 ux=vy,uy=−vx 开始。

解析函数具有所需的连续高阶偏导，因此混合偏导可交换；这里使用该先修性质，下面展示它怎样产生调和方程。

第一式对 x 求导、第二式对 y 求导，再相加：uxx+uyy=vyx−vxy=0。

对 v 也可直接算 vxx+vyy=−uyx+uxy=0。

曲线 u=c1 上的微小位移满足 uxdx+uydy=0，所以非零梯度 ∇u 是法向量。

对 v=c2 同样成立；再用 C–R 算得 ∇u·∇v=uxvx+uyvy=0。

若 f′(z0)≠0，则两梯度都非零，局部等值线有确定切线；将法向量都旋转90度不会改变内积，因此切线也垂直。

若导数为零，必须单独研究等值集，不能机械使用正交结论。

Start from C–R: ux=vy,uy=−vx.

Analytic functions have the required continuous higher partial derivatives, allowing mixed derivatives to commute.

Using that prior regularity fact, we can derive the harmonic equations.

Differentiate the first equation in x and the second in y, then add: uxx+uyy=vyx−vxy=0.

For v, direct calculation gives vxx+vyy=−uyx+uxy=0.

Along u=c1, a small displacement satisfies uxdx+uydy=0, so the nonzero gradient ∇u is normal to the curve.

The same holds for v=c2.

C–R then gives ∇u·∇v=uxvx+uyvy=0.

If f′(z0)≠0, both gradients are nonzero and the local level curves have definite tangents.

Rotating both normals by 90 degrees preserves their dot product, so the tangents are perpendicular.

At zero derivative, inspect the level sets separately.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

对 f(z)=z2=u(x,y)+iv(x,y)，说明 u 与 v 的等值线为什么在非原点处互相垂直。

For f(z)=z2=u(x,y)+iv(x,y), explain why the level curves of u and v are perpendicular away from the origin.

已知什么Given

z=x+iy。等值线的梯度是它的法向量，两个非零法向量内积为零时两条曲线垂直。

z=x+iy. The gradient of a level curve is its normal, and two curves are perpendicular when their nonzero normals have zero dot product.

要求什么Find

算出两个梯度并检验它们的内积。

Compute the two gradients and test their dot product.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1分离实部和虚部Separate real and imaginary parts
    为什么这样做Why this step

    等值线分别由 u 和 v 决定，必须先把它们写出来。

    The two level-curve families are defined by u and v, so first write both functions explicitly.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    f(z)=(x+iy)2=x2−y2+i(2xy)，所以 u=x2−y2、v=2xy。

    f(z)=(x+iy)2=x2−y2+i(2xy), so u=x2−y2 and v=2xy.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2计算两个梯度Compute both gradients
    为什么这样做Why this step

    梯度给出每族等值线在该点的法向方向。

    Each gradient gives the normal direction of its level curve at the point.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    ∇u=(ux,uy)=(2x,−2y)，∇v=(vx,vy)=(2y,2x)。

  3. 第 3 步Step 3计算内积Take the dot product
    为什么这样做Why this step

    内积为零正是两个法向量正交的代数判据。

    A zero dot product is the algebraic test for perpendicular normal vectors.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    ∇u·∇v=(2x)(2y)+(−2y)(2x)=4xy−4xy=0。

  4. 第 4 步Step 4排除退化点Exclude the degenerate point
    为什么这样做Why this step

    零向量没有方向，不能拿来判断曲线切线。

    A zero vector has no direction and cannot determine a curve tangent.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    当 (x,y)≠(0,0) 时，|∇u|=|∇v|=2x2+y2>0，因此两族等值线互相垂直。

    When (x,y)≠(0,0), |∇u|=|∇v|=2x2+y2>0, so the two level-curve families are perpendicular.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 在 (1,0) 处，两法向量分别为 (2,0) 和 (0,2)。

    At (1,0), the two normal vectors are (2,0) and (0,2).

  • 在原点两梯度都为零，所以结论必须写成“在非原点处”。

    At the origin both gradients vanish, so the conclusion must say 'away from the origin.'

  • u 与 v 都满足二维拉普拉斯方程，符合解析函数实虚部的性质。

    Both u and v satisfy the two-dimensional Laplace equation, as real and imaginary parts of an analytic function should.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

对 f(z)=ez，写出实部 u 和虚部 v。在点 (x,y)=(0,π/2)，求通过该点的两条等值线的切线方向，并判断是否垂直。

For f(z)=ez, write its real part u and imaginary part v. At (x,y)=(0,π/2), find tangent directions to the two level curves through the point and decide whether they are perpendicular.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

用 ex+iy=ex(cosy+isiny)，梯度是等值线的法向量。

Use ex+iy=ex(cosy+isiny); a gradient is normal to a level curve.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

先求 ∇u=(excosy,−exsiny) 和 ∇v=(exsiny,excosy)。

First compute ∇u=(excosy,−exsiny) and ∇v=(exsiny,excosy).

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

在指定点，两法向量为 (0,−1)、(1,0)；切线方向需分别与它们垂直。

At the specified point the normals are (0,−1) and (1,0); each tangent must be perpendicular to its corresponding normal.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    展开指数得到 u=excosy、v=exsiny。

    Expand the exponential to get u=excosy and v=exsiny.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    在指定点，它们的值分别为0和1，所以研究的是这两个值的等值线。

    Their values at the specified point are 0 and 1, respectively, which identifies the two level curves.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    求偏导后代入该点，得到 ∇u=(0,−1)、∇v=(1,0)。

    Differentiate and evaluate at that point: ∇u=(0,−1) and ∇v=(1,0).

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    二者均非零，因此两条局部等值线都有确定的切线。

    Both are nonzero, so both local level curves have well-defined tangents.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    与第一个法向量垂直的方向可取 (1,0)，与第二个垂直的方向可取 (0,1)。

    A direction perpendicular to the first normal is (1,0); one perpendicular to the second is (0,1).

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    两切向量内积为零，因此两条切线垂直。

    The tangent vectors have zero dot product, so the two tangents are perpendicular.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

也可检查 f′(iπ/2)=i≠0，正交结论的非临界条件满足。不要把梯度方向直接当成切线方向。

Alternatively check f′(iπ/2)=i≠0, confirming the noncritical-point condition. Do not mistake a gradient direction for a tangent direction.

调和是必要条件；正交结论别漏临界点。

Harmonicity is a necessary condition. Check critical points before claiming orthogonality.

SECTION 1.4 · 教材 p.20SECTION 1.4 · Textbook p.20

复积分与柯西公式Complex integration and the Cauchy formula

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

柯西积分公式与积分估计Cauchy integral formula and integral bounds

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

一个闭合圈上的积分，可以告诉你圈内某一点的函数值或导数。先圈出分母对应的点，并检查它是否在路径内部。

An integral around a closed curve can give a function value or derivative inside. Locate the denominator’s special point first and check that it lies inside the curve.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

路径上含共轭、实部或虚部时，通常直接参数化；解析函数的闭路积分先看区域内奇点。柯西公式把积分转换成某点的函数值或导数。

If the integrand contains a conjugate, real part, or imaginary part, parameterizing the path is usually the direct approach. For a closed contour, first locate the singularities inside. The Cauchy formula turns an integral into a function value or derivative at one point.

∮Cf(z)(z−a)n+1dz=2πin!f(n)(a),|∫Cgdz|≤ML
使用条件When it applies

f 在正向简单闭曲线及其内部解析，a 在内部；估计中 M 是路径上模的上界，L 是路径长。

f is analytic on and inside a positively oriented simple closed curve; a is inside. In the estimate, M bounds the modulus on the path and L is its length.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

先说明先修：这里使用柯西积分定理，推导积分公式及估计，不把柯西定理本身当作已经证明。

若 a 在内部且 f 解析，可把围道变形到 a 周围逆时针小圆；两条围道之间没有奇点。

把 f(z)/(z−a) 拆成 f(a)/(z−a)+[f(z)−f(a)]/(z−a)。

第二部分在 a 附近有界，乘趋零的圆周长后积分趋零；第一部分用 z−a=εeit 得 f(a)∫02πidt=2πif(a)。

因为 a 与固定围道保持正距离，可以对公式中的参数 a 逐次求导。

核的导数为 dn[(z−a)−1]/dan=n!(z−a)−n−1，因此 ∮Cf(z)/(z−a)n+1dz=2πif(n)(a)/n!。

这也解释了阶乘从何而来。

积分估计使用三角不等式：|∫Cgdz|≤∫C|g||dz|。

若路径上 |g|≤M，再得 ∫C|g||dz|≤M∫C|dz|=ML。

估计不要求 g 解析，只要求可积及该上界。

自检条件：公式要求 f 在曲线及内部解析，a 严格在内部，方向为正向。

奇点在曲线上时不能直接套；若方向反转，积分变号。

Prerequisite: this derivation uses Cauchy integral theorem to establish the formula and estimate; it does not prove that theorem itself.

If a is inside and f is analytic, deform the contour to a small counterclockwise circle around a, with no singularities between the contours.

Split f(z)/(z−a) into f(a)/(z−a)+[f(z)−f(a)]/(z−a).

The second part is bounded near a, so its small-circle integral vanishes with the circumference.

In the first part, z−a=εeit gives f(a)∫02πidt=2πif(a).

Because a stays a positive distance from the fixed contour, differentiate the formula with respect to the parameter a.

The kernel derivative is dn[(z−a)−1]/dan=n!(z−a)−n−1, yielding ∮Cf(z)/(z−a)n+1dz=2πif(n)(a)/n!.

This explains the factorial.

The integral estimate follows from |∫Cgdz|≤∫C|g||dz|.

If |g|≤M along the path, then ∫C|g||dz|≤M∫C|dz|=ML.

This estimate needs integrability and the bound, not analyticity of g.

Check the conditions: f must be analytic on and inside the curve, a must lie strictly inside, and the orientation must be positive.

A singularity on the contour prevents direct use; reversing orientation reverses the integral sign.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

沿圆 |z|=2 逆时针计算 ∮|z|=2ezz3dz。

Along |z|=2, evaluate ∮|z|=2ezz3dz counterclockwise.

已知什么Given

积分路径包围 z=0。高阶柯西公式为 ∮Cf(z)(z−a)n+1dz=2πin!f(n)(a)。

The contour encloses z=0. The generalized Cauchy formula is ∮Cf(z)(z−a)n+1dz=2πin!f(n)(a).

要求什么Find

识别导数阶数并算出积分。

Identify the derivative order and evaluate the integral.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1匹配公式的分母Match the denominator to the formula
    为什么这样做Why this step

    导数阶数由分母指数减一得到。

    The derivative order is one less than the denominator exponent.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    z3=(z−0)2+1，所以 a=0、n=2，分子取 f(z)=ez。

    z3=(z−0)2+1, so a=0, n=2, and the numerator function is f(z)=ez.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2计算需要的导数Compute the required derivative
    为什么这样做Why this step

    公式要求的是二阶导数在圆内点 a=0 的值。

    The formula needs the second derivative at the enclosed point a=0.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    f′(z)=ez、f″(z)=ez，因此 f″(0)=1。

    f′(z)=ez and f″(z)=ez, so f″(0)=1.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3代入高阶柯西公式Substitute into Cauchy's formula
    为什么这样做Why this step

    路径逆时针且 z=0 在圆内，可以直接使用正号公式。

    The contour is counterclockwise and z=0 is inside, so the formula has its positive sign.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    ∮|z|=2ezz3dz=2πi2!f″(0)=2πi2=πi。

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • ez/z3=z−3+z−2+12z−1+⋯，负一次幂系数是 1/2。

    ez/z3=z−3+z−2+12z−1+⋯, whose coefficient of the minus-first power is 1/2.

  • 用留数检查得到 2πi×(1/2)=πi。

    The residue check gives 2πi×(1/2)=πi.

  • 若把 z3 误认成三阶导数，会多算一阶。

    Treating z3 as a third derivative would introduce one derivative too many.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

圆周 C:|z−1|=1/2 按逆时针方向。计算 I=∮Ccosz/(z−1)2dz。

The circle C:|z−1|=1/2 is traversed counterclockwise. Evaluate I=∮Ccosz/(z−1)2dz.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

分母是二次幂，选柯西公式的一阶导数形式。

The denominator is squared, so use the first-derivative form of Cauchy's formula.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

公式为 ∮Cf(z)/(z−a)2dz=2πif′(a)。先认出 a=1。

The formula is ∮Cf(z)/(z−a)2dz=2πif′(a). Identify a=1 first.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

这里 f(z)=cosz，故 f′(1)=−sin1。

Here f(z)=cosz, so f′(1)=−sin1.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    先检查条件：cosz 在整个复平面解析，点 z=1 位于圆周内部，且路径取正向。

    Check the conditions first: cosz is entire, z=1 is inside the circle, and the path has positive orientation.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    柯西导数公式可以直接使用。

    Cauchy's derivative formula applies directly.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    把分母写成 (z−a)n+1 对照，得到 a=1,n=1。

    Compare the denominator with (z−a)n+1 to identify a=1,n=1.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    这里不是函数值公式，必须求一次导数。

    This requires one derivative rather than a function value.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    有 f′(z)=−sinz，代入得 I=2πi(−sin1)=−2πisin1。

    Since f′(z)=−sinz, substitution gives I=2πi(−sin1)=−2πisin1.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

局部展开 cosz=cos1−sin1(z−1)+⋯，被积函数的留数确为 −sin1。常见错误：二阶分母却代入函数值。

Expand locally: cosz=cos1−sin1(z−1)+⋯, so the residue of the integrand is indeed −sin1. A common error is using the function value despite the squared denominator.

SECTION 1.5 · 教材 p.27SECTION 1.5 · Textbook p.27

幂级数与奇点Power series and singularities

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

泰勒、洛朗展开及收敛环域Taylor and Laurent expansions and their annuli

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

展开式就是把难算的函数改写成一串容易处理的幂。先标出离展开中心最近的奇点；区域选错，即使算式看起来对，也不能使用。

A series replaces a function with manageable powers. Locate singularities around the expansion center first: the region determines which expansion is valid.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

同一个有理函数在不同环域有不同级数。先平移中心，再按距离中心的各个奇点划分圆环；每个因子都应变为绝对值小于一的几何级数。

The same rational function can have different series in different annuli. First shift the expansion center. Use the distances to the singularities to divide the plane into rings. Rewrite each factor as a geometric series whose ratio has modulus less than one.

11−w=∑n=0∞wn (|w|<1),R−1=lim supn→∞|an|1/n
使用条件When it applies

幂级数内部绝对收敛；边界要逐点检验。洛朗级数只在指定环域成立。

A power series converges absolutely inside its convergence disk. Check the boundary point by point. A Laurent series is valid only in its stated annulus.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

先从最常用的几何展开推起。

有限和 SN=1+w+⋯+wN 满足 (1−w)SN=1−wN+1；当 |w|<1 时，wN+1→0，所以 1/(1−w)=∑n≥0wn。

对幂级数 ∑an(z−z0)n，设 L=lim sup|an|1/n。

通项的根值上极限是 L|z−z0|；小于1时绝对收敛，大于1时发散，故半径 R=1/L。

约定 L=0 时 R=∞，L=∞ 时 R=0。

边界满足根值上极限等于1，根值判别在这里不作决定。

必须回到边界上的具体级数，检查通项、交错或 Dirichlet 等条件，不能把收敛圆域直接写成闭圆盘。

洛朗展开允许 w=z−z0 的负幂。

某一因子在外域可写成 1/(w−a)=w−1/(1−a/w)，小公比是 a/w；内域则用 −a−1/(1−w/a)。

各因子的条件取交集，才得到整式的环域。

一般解析函数为什么在环域内有唯一洛朗展开，需要洛朗定理及其围道证明；上面的几何推导并不替代该定理。

考试中处理有理式时，这套改写能直接生成展开，而最近奇点决定不能跨越的最大圆域或环域边界。

Begin with the geometric expansion used most often.

The finite sum SN=1+w+⋯+wN satisfies (1−w)SN=1−wN+1.

If |w|<1, then wN+1→0, giving 1/(1−w)=∑n≥0wn.

For ∑an(z−z0)n, set L=lim sup|an|1/n.

The root limsup of its terms is L|z−z0|.

Values below one give absolute convergence and values above one give divergence, so R=1/L.

Use R=∞ when L=0 and R=0 when L=∞.

At the boundary the root limsup equals one, so the root test is inconclusive.

Analyze the actual boundary series using term limits, alternation, Dirichlet test, or another suitable method.

The convergence disk is not automatically closed.

Laurent expansions allow negative powers of w=z−z0.

In an exterior region write 1/(w−a)=w−1/(1−a/w), with small ratio a/w.

In an interior region use −a−1/(1−w/a).

Intersect the conditions of every factor to obtain the region for the complete expression.

Existence and uniqueness of a Laurent expansion for a general analytic function on an annulus require Laurent theorem and its contour proof; the geometric derivation does not replace that theorem.

For rational-function exercises, these rewrites generate the series directly, while singularities limit maximal disks or annuli.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

在区域 |z|>1 中，把 11+z 展开成洛朗级数。

In the region |z|>1, expand 11+z as a Laurent series.

已知什么Given

几何级数 11+q=∑n=0∞(−1)nqn 只在 |q|<1 时成立。

The geometric series 11+q=∑n=0∞(−1)nqn is valid only when |q|<1.

要求什么Find

选出在给定区域内小于 1 的展开变量，并写明收敛域。

Choose an expansion variable whose modulus is below 1 in the stated region, and give the convergence region.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1根据区域选择小量Choose the small quantity from the region
    为什么这样做Why this step

    |z|>1 时 z 不小，但 z−1 的模小于一。

    When |z|>1, the quantity z is not small, but the modulus of z−1 is below one.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    |z|>1⇒|z−1|<1，所以要用 z−1 作几何级数的变量。

    |z|>1⇒|z−1|<1, so use z−1 as the geometric-series variable.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2从分母提出 $z$Factor $z$ from the denominator
    为什么这样做Why this step

    提出 z 后，分母就变成含小量 z−1 的形式。

    After factoring z, the denominator contains the small quantity z−1.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    11+z=z−11+z−1。

  3. 第 3 步Step 3套用几何级数Apply the geometric series
    为什么这样做Why this step

    现在公比的模小于一，展开条件已经满足。

    The new ratio has modulus below one, so the expansion condition now holds.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    11+z=z−1∑n=0∞(−1)nz−n=∑n=0∞(−1)nz−n−1。

  4. 第 4 步Step 4写出前几项和区域Show the first terms and region
    为什么这样做Why this step

    前几项能看清幂次与正负号，收敛域是答案的一部分。

    The first terms display the powers and signs, and the convergence region belongs in the answer.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    11+z=z−1−z−2+z−3−z−4+⋯，收敛域为 |z|>1。

    11+z=z−1−z−2+z−3−z−4+⋯, with convergence region |z|>1.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 取 z=2，级数成为 1/2−1/4+1/8−⋯=1/3。

    At z=2, the series becomes 1/2−1/4+1/8−⋯=1/3.

  • 原函数在 z=−1 有奇点，所以以原点展开时边界半径应为 1。

    The original function is singular at z=−1, so an expansion about the origin should have boundary radius 1.

  • 所得级数只有负幂，符合外部区域 |z|>1 的洛朗展开。

    The series contains only negative powers, as expected for the outer region |z|>1.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

以原点为中心，将 f(z)=1/(z−2) 在 |z|>2 展开为洛朗级数。写出前三项和一般项，并说明为何不含非负次幂。

Expand f(z)=1/(z−2) as a Laurent series about the origin for |z|>2. Give its first three terms and general term, and explain the absence of nonnegative powers.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

几何级数的小量要是 2/z，不是 z/2。

The small quantity in the geometric series must be 2/z, not z/2.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

改写 1/(z−2)=z−1/(1−2/z)。

Rewrite 1/(z−2)=z−1/(1−2/z).

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

用 1/(1−q)=∑n=0∞qn，条件为 |q|<1。

Use 1/(1−q)=∑n=0∞qn, valid for |q|<1.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    题目要求外侧区域，所以把分母中的大变量先提出来：z−2=z(1−2/z)。

    The requested region is exterior, so factor out the large variable: z−2=z(1−2/z).

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    此时 |2/z|<1，正好满足几何级数条件。

    Now |2/z|<1, exactly the geometric-series condition.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    代入几何级数得 f(z)=z−1∑n=0∞(2/z)n=∑n=0∞2nz−n−1。

    Substitution gives f(z)=z−1∑n=0∞(2/z)n=∑n=0∞2nz−n−1.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    前三项是 z−1+2z−2+4z−3。

    The first three terms are z−1+2z−2+4z−3.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    一般指数为 −n−1 且 n≥0，所以全部为负幂；这个展开只在 |z|>2 使用。

    The exponent is −n−1 with n≥0, so every power is negative; this expansion is used only for |z|>2.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

把级数乘以 z−2，相邻项相消后只留下1。常见错误：选成 z/2 会得到另一收敛区域，不能用于本题。

Multiply the series by z−2: adjacent terms cancel and leave 1. Choosing z/2 instead gives a different convergence region and does not answer this question.

合上答案重做一次，仍卡住可用下方按钮加入记忆回顾。Close the solution and try again. Use the button below to add this concept to recall if you still need help.

记忆线索Memory cue

先画奇点距离，再决定展开变量是 z 还是 1/z。

Mark the singularity distances first. Then decide whether the small expansion variable is z or 1/z.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

可去、极点与本性奇点Removable singularities, poles, and essential singularities

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

分母为零，不一定就是极点：分子也可能抵消它。先展开或约去共同因子，再看还剩多少负次幂。

A zero denominator does not automatically mean a pole: the numerator may cancel it. Expand or cancel common factors, then inspect the remaining negative powers.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

洛朗级数的负幂部分决定孤立奇点类型。无穷远改用 w=1/z，但若有限奇点不断趋于无穷远，无穷远就不是孤立奇点。

The negative-power part of a Laurent series classifies an isolated singularity. At infinity, use w=1/z. If finite singularities continue out toward infinity, infinity is not isolated.

f(z)=∑n=−∞∞an(z−a)n
使用条件When it applies

必须先确认奇点孤立，才能使用这三类。

First verify that the singularity is isolated. Only then do these three categories apply.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

先确认 a 是孤立奇点：存在某个去心圆盘 0<|z−a|<r，函数在其中解析。

只有这时才能写洛朗展开，并用负幂部分作下面三分类；支点或非孤立奇点不能直接套。

若没有任何负幂，级数从常数项 a0 开始，就是普通幂级数。

把缺少的点补成 f(a)=a0，同一级数便在整个圆盘解析，所以称为可去奇点。

若最低幂为 −m 且其系数非零，乘 (z−a)m 后没有负幂，且在 a 的值不为零。

于是 f=g(z)/(z−a)m，其中 g 在 a 解析且非零，这正是 m 阶极点的形式。

若负幂无穷多个，任何有限次幂都不能把它们全部消去，既不是可去，也不是有限阶极点，称为本性奇点。

判断分母为零处时，应先展开或比较分子分母的零点阶数，避免漏掉约消。

First ensure that a is isolated: the function must be analytic in some punctured disk 0<|z−a|<r.

Only then can its Laurent negative-power part be used for the following classification.

Branch points and nonisolated singularities are outside this rule.

If there are no negative powers, the series starts with a constant term a0 and is an ordinary power series.

Defining f(a)=a0 extends the same analytic series to the full disk, making the singularity removable.

If the lowest power is −m with a nonzero coefficient, multiplication by (z−a)m removes every negative power and leaves a nonzero value at a.

Thus f=g(z)/(z−a)m, with g analytic and nonzero at a, exactly the form of a pole of order m.

If infinitely many negative powers occur, no finite power removes them all.

The point is neither removable nor a finite-order pole and is called essential.

At a denominator zero, expand or compare numerator and denominator zero orders first, so cancellations are not missed.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

判断 sinzz 在 z=0 处的奇点类型，并给出可解析延拓时的补值。

Classify the singularity of sinzz at z=0, and give the value for an analytic extension if one exists.

已知什么Given

分子和分母在 z=0 都为零，不能只看分母就判断极点。

Both numerator and denominator vanish at z=0, so the denominator alone cannot identify a pole.

要求什么Find

用局部级数判断是否存在负幂，并求极限值。

Use a local series to test for negative powers and find the limiting value.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1展开分子Expand the numerator
    为什么这样做Why this step

    泰勒级数能直接显示零点阶数和局部幂次。

    The Taylor series directly displays the zero order and all local powers.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    sinz=z−z33!+z55!−⋯。

  2. 第 2 步Step 2逐项除以 $z$Divide each term by $z$
    为什么这样做Why this step

    约去共同的一阶零点后，就能看出是否还有发散项。

    After canceling the common simple zero, we can see whether any divergent terms remain.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    sinzz=1−z23!+z45!−⋯。

  3. 第 3 步Step 3判断奇点类型Classify the singularity
    为什么这样做Why this step

    洛朗级数没有负幂时，孤立奇点可以通过补值去掉。

    When the Laurent series has no negative powers, the isolated singularity can be removed by filling in a value.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    展开式没有任何负幂，且 limz→0sinzz=1，所以 z=0 是可去奇点。

    There are no negative powers, and limz→0sinzz=1, so z=0 is removable.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4写出延拓值State the extension value
    为什么这样做Why this step

    把缺失点补成极限值后，级数在原点仍然解析。

    Filling in the limiting value keeps the power series analytic at the origin.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    定义 f(0)=1，则延拓后的 f(z) 在整个复平面解析。

    Define f(0)=1; the extended f(z) is then analytic on the entire complex plane.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 补值后的级数首项为 1，所以函数在 z=0 连续。

    The extended series begins with 1, so the function is continuous at z=0.

  • 展开中没有 (z−0)−1 或更低幂，因此不是极点也不是本性奇点。

    No term (z−0)−1 or lower occurs, so the point is neither a pole nor an essential singularity.

  • 沿实轴取极限也得到 limx→0sinxx=1。

    The real-axis limit also gives limx→0sinxx=1.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

函数 f(z)=(1−cosz)/z2 在 z=0 处未定义。判断这个孤立奇点的类型，并求能使函数在原点解析的补定义值。

The function f(z)=(1−cosz)/z2 is undefined at z=0. Classify this isolated singularity and find the value that makes the function analytic at the origin.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

不要只看分母；先检查分子在原点消失了几阶。

Do not inspect the denominator alone; find the order to which the numerator vanishes.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

使用 cosz=1−z2/2+z4/24−⋯。

Use cosz=1−z2/2+z4/24−⋯.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

相减再除以 z2，看看是否还存在负幂。

Subtract and divide by z2, then check whether any negative powers remain.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    余弦在原点的展开给出 1−cosz=z2/2−z4/24+⋯。

    The cosine expansion gives 1−cosz=z2/2−z4/24+⋯.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    分子也有二阶零点，正好可以消去分母的二阶零点。

    The numerator has a zero of order two, which cancels the zero of the same order in the denominator.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    在穿孔邻域内相除得 f(z)=1/2−z2/24+⋯。

    Division in a punctured neighborhood gives f(z)=1/2−z2/24+⋯.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    没有负幂项，因此它不是极点，也不是本性奇点，而是可去奇点。

    There are no negative powers, so this is a removable singularity rather than a pole or an essential singularity.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    展开的常数项就是极限：limz→0f(z)=1/2。

    The constant term gives the limit: limz→0f(z)=1/2.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    补定义 f(0)=1/2 后，所得幂级数在原点附近解析。

    Define f(0)=1/2; the resulting power series is analytic near the origin.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

检查分子首项确为 z2/2。常见错误：看到分母平方就称为二阶极点，漏掉分子消零。

Check that the leading numerator term is z2/2. A common error is calling this a second-order pole from the denominator alone, overlooking cancellation.

先消零点，再判阶数；分母为零不一定是极点。

Cancel zeros before determining the order. A zero denominator does not always produce a pole.

SECTION 1.6 · 教材 p.40SECTION 1.6 · Textbook p.40

留数定理Residue theorem

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

留数与高阶极点Residues and poles of higher order

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

留数就是局部展开中负一次幂的系数。算围道积分时，先找圈内有哪些奇点，再逐个取这个系数。

The residue is the coefficient of the minus-first power in a local Laurent series. For a contour integral, locate the enclosed singularities and find that coefficient at each one.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

留数是洛朗展开中 (z−a)−1 的系数。简单极点用极限，高阶极点用求导，本性奇点通常展开后取系数。

A residue is the coefficient of (z−a)−1 in a Laurent expansion. Use a limit for a simple pole, derivatives for a higher-order pole, and usually a series coefficient for an essential singularity.

Resz=af=1(m−1)![dm−1dzm−1((z−a)mf)]z=a
使用条件When it applies

a 为 m 阶极点；正向闭路积分为 2πi 乘内部留数和。

a is a pole of order m. A positively oriented closed-contour integral equals 2πi times the sum of enclosed residues.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

先记住留数的定义：洛朗展开中 (z−a)−1 的系数。

若 a 是 m 阶极点，令 g(z)=(z−a)mf(z)，则 g 在 a 解析，能作泰勒展开。

把 g(z)=∑j≥0g(j)(a)(z−a)j/j! 除以 (z−a)m，各项幂次变成 j−m。

要得到负一次，解 j−m=−1，因此 j=m−1。

所以留数就是 g(m−1)(a)/(m−1)!。

这解释了“极点阶数减一再求导”：单极点不用求导，二阶极点求一次，三阶极点求两次。

该公式针对极点，本性奇点通常改用展开取系数。

利用洛朗级数在小圆上一致收敛，可以逐项积分。

在小圆上令 z−a=εeit，可算得 ∮(z−a)kdz=0（整数 k≠−1），而 k=−1 时为 2πi。

围道上无奇点且内部只有有限个孤立奇点时，由柯西定理把大围道缩成这些奇点的小圆，得到闭路积分等于 2πi 乘内部留数和；方向反转时变号。

A residue is the coefficient of (z−a)−1 in a Laurent expansion.

If a is a pole of order m, define g(z)=(z−a)mf(z).

The function g is analytic at a and has a Taylor expansion.

Divide g(z)=∑j≥0g(j)(a)(z−a)j/j! by (z−a)m.

The exponents become j−m.

Solving j−m=−1 selects j=m−1.

The residue is therefore g(m−1)(a)/(m−1)!.

This explains why the derivative order is one below the pole order: zero derivatives for a simple pole, one for a double pole, and two for a triple pole.

This formula is for poles; essential singularities usually require coefficient extraction.

Uniform convergence of the Laurent series on a small circle permits termwise integration.

Set z−a=εeit.

Then ∮(z−a)kdz=0 for integers k≠−1, while k=−1 gives 2πi.

When the contour has no singularity on it and only finitely many isolated singularities inside, Cauchy theorem deforms it into small circles around them, giving 2πi times their residue sum.

Reversing orientation reverses the sign.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

求 f(z)=ez(z−1)2 在 z=1 处的留数。

Find the residue of f(z)=ez(z−1)2 at z=1.

已知什么Given

z=1 是二阶极点。若 a 是 m 阶极点，则 Resz=af=1(m−1)![dm−1dzm−1(z−a)mf(z)]z=a。

z=1 is a second-order pole. If a is a pole of order m, then Resz=af=1(m−1)![dm−1dzm−1(z−a)mf(z)]z=a.

要求什么Find

正确使用二阶极点公式，找出负一次幂的系数。

Apply the second-order pole formula correctly and find the coefficient of the minus-first power.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1确定极点阶数Identify the pole order
    为什么这样做Why this step

    阶数决定要乘回多少因子以及求几次导数。

    The order determines how many factors to cancel and how many derivatives to take.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    分母是 (z−1)2，而 e1≠0，所以 a=1、m=2。

    The denominator is (z−1)2 and e1≠0, so a=1 and m=2.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2乘回极点因子Cancel the pole factor
    为什么这样做Why this step

    这样会留下在 z=1 附近解析的函数。

    This leaves a function analytic near z=1.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    g(z)=(z−1)2f(z)=ez。

  3. 第 3 步Step 3求一次导数并代入Differentiate once and substitute
    为什么这样做Why this step

    m−1=1，因此二阶极点只要求一次导数。

    Because m−1=1, a second-order pole requires only one derivative.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    Resz=1f=g′(1)1!=e11=e。

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • ez=e[1+(z−1)+(z−1)22!+⋯]。

  • 除以 (z−1)2 后，(z−1)−1 的系数正是 e。

    After division by (z−1)2, the coefficient of (z−1)−1 is exactly e.

  • 公式分母是 (m−1)!=1!，不是 2!。

    The denominator in the formula is (m−1)!=1!, not 2!.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

求 f(z)=z2/(z+2)3 在 z=−2 处的留数；再求逆时针圆周 |z+2|=1 上的积分 ∮f(z)dz。

Find the residue of f(z)=z2/(z+2)3 at z=−2, then evaluate ∮f(z)dz on the counterclockwise circle |z+2|=1.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

这里是三阶极点；留数仍然只取一次负幂的系数。

This is a third-order pole, but its residue is still the coefficient of the first negative power.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

可令 w=z+2，把分子写成 (w−2)2。

You can set w=z+2 and write the numerator as (w−2)2.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

展开得到 f=w−1−4w−2+4w−3；找到所需系数后乘 2πi。

Expansion gives f=w−1−4w−2+4w−3; take the required coefficient and multiply by 2πi.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    分子在 z=−2 处等于4，不会消去分母，所以极点的阶数确为三阶。

    The numerator equals 4 at z=−2 and does not cancel the denominator, so the pole really has order three.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    先确认阶数，避免错误套用简单极点公式。

    Confirm the order before choosing a residue formula.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    令 w=z+2，有 z=w−2，所以 f=(w2−4w+4)/w3=w−1−4w−2+4w−3。

    Set w=z+2, giving z=w−2 and f=(w2−4w+4)/w3=w−1−4w−2+4w−3.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    留数是 w−1 的系数，因此 Resz=−2f=1。

    The residue is the coefficient of w−1, hence Resz=−2f=1.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    圆周内只有这个极点，留数定理给 ∮f(z)dz=2πi。

    This is the only pole inside the circle, so the residue theorem gives ∮f(z)dz=2πi.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

高阶公式也给 12!(z2)′′|z=−2=1。别把三阶极点的最高负幂系数4当成留数。

The higher-order formula also gives 12!(z2)′′|z=−2=1. Do not confuse the coefficient 4 of the most negative power with the residue.

记忆线索Memory cue

留数只取负一次；极点阶数减一再求导。

Only the power minus one determines the residue. Subtract one from the pole order to get the derivative order.

SECTION 1.7 · 教材 p.45SECTION 1.7 · Textbook p.45

留数计算实积分Real integrals by residues

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

实积分的围道选择Choosing a contour for a real integral

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

实轴积分可以借助复平面中的闭合路线来算。路线要让多出来的一段能算、或能证明趋近于零；先看指数衰减和极点的位置。

Close a real integral along a suitable route in the complex plane. Choose the route by locating poles and finding where any exponential decays, then control the added pieces.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

有理函数衰减够快时闭合上半圆；带 eikx 时根据 k 的符号选择半平面；三角积分令 z=eiθ；幂函数可使用扇形或钥匙孔围道。

For a sufficiently decaying rational function, close with an upper semicircle. With eikx, choose the half-plane from the sign of k. For a trigonometric integral, set z=eiθ. Powers may suggest a sector or keyhole contour.

∫−∞∞R(x)eikxdx=2πi∑Ima>0Resz=a(R(z)eikz)
使用条件When it applies

上式要求 k>0、实轴无极点及大圆弧积分消失。实轴有极点时先说明是否取主值，小凹口会贡献半留数。

The displayed formula requires k>0, no poles on the real axis, and a vanishing large-arc integral. With real-axis poles, state whether a principal value is intended. A small indentation contributes half a residue term.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

先决定在哪个半平面闭合：eik(x+iy)=eikxe−ky。

当 k>0，上半平面 y>0 使它衰减；若 k<0，则换到下半平面，并重新检查围道方向。

把逆时针上半圆围道拆成实轴段与大圆弧，留数定理给 ∫−RRf(x)dx+∫arcf(z)dz=2πi∑ra。

只有另行证明弧积分趋零后，才可把闭路结果当作实积分；指数在内部衰减本身还不是完整证明。

有理函数若在弧上有 O(R−2) 的统一上界，乘弧长 πR 就得 O(R−1)→0。

带复指数时，可在满足衰减条件的情况下使用 Jordan 引理；若相关条件缺失，就不能省略大弧项。

实轴上有单极点 a 时，普通反常积分通常发散，须另说是否求主值。

上方小凹口从左到右是顺时针，令 z=a+εeit、t:π→0，就有小弧极限 ra∫π0idt=−iπra。

最后再取需要的实部或虚部。

把半轴积分变成全轴的一半还需检查原实被积函数为偶函数，不能只看分母是否偶对称。

Choose the half-plane from eik(x+iy)=eikxe−ky.

For k>0, the factor decays when y>0, so close above.

For k<0, close below and check the contour orientation anew.

Split a counterclockwise upper semicircle into its real segment and large arc: ∫−RRf(x)dx+∫arcf(z)dz=2πi∑ra.

The closed-contour result becomes the real integral only after proving the arc vanishes.

Interior exponential decay alone is not a complete proof.

If a rational integrand has a uniform O(R−2) bound on the arc, multiplication by length πR gives O(R−1)→0.

With an exponential, Jordan lemma can be used under its required decay conditions.

If the conditions fail, the arc term cannot be discarded.

With a simple pole a on the real axis, the ordinary improper integral generally diverges; state separately whether a principal value is intended.

An upper indentation from left to right is clockwise.

Set z=a+εeit, t:π→0, to get the small-arc limit ra∫π0idt=−iπra.

Finally take the required real or imaginary part.

A half-line integral is half the full-line value only when the original real integrand is even; symmetry of the denominator alone is insufficient.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

计算 I=∫−∞∞dxx2+a2，其中 a>0。

Evaluate I=∫−∞∞dxx2+a2, where a>0.

已知什么Given

把实变量换成复变量 z，并取上半平面半圆围道。圆弧半径记为 R，最后令 R→∞。

Replace the real variable by the complex variable z and use an upper-half-plane semicircular contour. Let the arc radius be R, then take R→∞.

要求什么Find

找出围道内的极点，证明大圆弧积分消失，再用留数定理求 I。

Find the pole inside the contour, prove that the large-arc integral vanishes, and use the residue theorem to find I.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1分解分母Factor the denominator
    为什么这样做Why this step

    因式分解能直接显示复平面中的极点位置。

    Factoring directly displays the pole locations in the complex plane.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    z2+a2=(z−ia)(z+ia)，所以极点是 z=ia 和 z=−ia。

    z2+a2=(z−ia)(z+ia), so the poles are z=ia and z=−ia.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2选择围道内的极点Select the enclosed pole
    为什么这样做Why this step

    a>0 时只有 z=ia 位于上半平面。

    Because a>0, only z=ia lies in the upper half-plane.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    上半圆围道只包围 z=ia，而 z=−ia 在下半平面外。

    The upper semicircular contour encloses z=ia, while z=−ia lies outside in the lower half-plane.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3计算留数Compute the residue
    为什么这样做Why this step

    z=ia 是一阶极点，可以约去对应的一次因子后代入。

    z=ia is a simple pole, so cancel its linear factor and substitute.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    Resz=ia1z2+a2=1z+ia|z=ia=12ia。

  4. 第 4 步Step 4估计大圆弧Bound the large arc
    为什么这样做Why this step

    只有证明圆弧部分趋于零，围道积分才能化成原实积分。

    The contour integral becomes the original real integral only after the arc term is shown to vanish.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    在 |z|=R>a 上，|z2+a2|≥R2−a2，故圆弧积分的模不超过 πRR2−a2→0。

    On |z|=R>a, |z2+a2|≥R2−a2, so the arc integral has modulus at most πRR2−a2→0.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5使用留数定理Apply the residue theorem
    为什么这样做Why this step

    令 R→∞ 后，闭合围道中只剩实轴积分。

    After R→∞, only the real-axis integral remains in the closed contour.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    I=2πiResz=ia1z2+a2=2πi·12ia=πa。

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 被积函数在实轴上为正，所以结果 π/a 也应为正。

    The real integrand is positive, so the result π/a should also be positive.

  • 令 a=1，得到熟悉的 ∫−∞∞dx1+x2=π。

    For a=1, this gives the familiar result ∫−∞∞dx1+x2=π.

  • 量纲上，被积函数积分后的量纲是 1/a，与 π/a 一致。

    Dimensionally, the integral has units of 1/a, matching π/a.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

用上半平面半圆围道求 I=∫−∞∞x2/[(x2+1)(x2+9)]dx。说明上半平面有哪些极点以及大圆弧为什么消失。

Use an upper-half-plane semicircular contour to evaluate I=∫−∞∞x2/[(x2+1)(x2+9)]dx. Identify the enclosed poles and explain why the large-arc integral vanishes.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

有理函数在无穷远按 1/z2 衰减，适合闭合半圆。

The rational function decays like 1/z2 at infinity, making a semicircle suitable.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

上半平面的极点为 z=i,3i，都是简单极点。

The upper-half-plane poles are z=i,3i, both simple.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

两个留数分别为 i/16 和 −3i/16，先相加再乘 2πi。

The residues are i/16 and −3i/16; add them before multiplying by 2πi.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    令 F(z)=z2/[(z−i)(z+i)(z−3i)(z+3i)]。

    Set F(z)=z2/[(z−i)(z+i)(z−3i)(z+3i)].

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    沿实轴从左到右，再经大上半圆返回，方向为逆时针；内部只有两个上半平面极点。

    Travel from left to right on the real axis and return on a large upper semicircle; this is counterclockwise and encloses only the two upper-half-plane poles.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    对简单极点去掉对应的一次因子再代入。

    At a simple pole remove its linear factor and substitute.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    由此 ResiF=(−1)/[(2i)(8)]=i/16，以及 Res3iF=(−9)/[(−8)(6i)]=−3i/16。

    This gives ResiF=(−1)/[(2i)(8)]=i/16 and Res3iF=(−9)/[(−8)(6i)]=−3i/16.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    大圆弧上被积函数为 O(R−2)，弧长为 πR，故弧积分为 O(R−1)，趋于零。

    On the large arc the integrand is O(R−2) and the arc length is πR, so its integral is O(R−1) and vanishes.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    取足够大的半径也避开了所有固定极点。

    A sufficiently large radius also avoids all fixed poles.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    实积分因此等于 2πi(i/16−3i/16)=π/4。

    The real integral is therefore 2πi(i/16−3i/16)=π/4.

  8. 第 8 步Step 8

    原函数非负，结果为正，与符号检查一致。

    The original integrand is nonnegative, agreeing with the positive result.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

可用分式 F(x)=−1/[8(x2+1)]+9/[8(x2+9)] 独立检验。常见错误：把下半平面两极点也算进去。

Independently check with F(x)=−1/[8(x2+1)]+9/[8(x2+9)]. A common error is including the two lower-half-plane poles as well.

记忆线索Memory cue

先验收敛与实轴极点，再选围道；半轴偶函数记得除二。

Check convergence and real-axis poles before choosing the contour. For an even integrand, remember to halve the whole-line result.

SECTION 1.8 · 教材 p.58SECTION 1.8 · Textbook p.58

色散关系Dispersion relations

本节无书后习题No end-of-section exercises
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

实部与虚部的 Hilbert 变换联系Hilbert-transform relations between real and imaginary parts

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

解析性会把实部与虚部联系起来，它们并不是两个可随意指定的函数。先检查所在半平面、无穷远衰减以及主值积分的约定。

Analyticity links the real and imaginary parts; they cannot be prescribed independently. Check the half-plane, decay at infinity, and principal-value convention first.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

上半平面解析且在无穷远衰减的函数，其边界实部与虚部不是独立的。绕实轴点的小半圆产生半留数，从而得到主值公式。

If a function is analytic in the upper half-plane and decays at infinity, its boundary real and imaginary parts are linked. A small semicircle around a real-axis point supplies half a residue term and leads to a principal-value formula.

u(x)=1πPV∫−∞∞v(t)t−xdt,v(x)=−1πPV∫−∞∞u(t)t−xdt
使用条件When it applies

f 在闭上半平面满足相应解析性、边界正则性及足够衰减；积分为柯西主值。

f must satisfy the appropriate analyticity, boundary regularity, and decay conditions in the closed upper half-plane. The integrals are Cauchy principal values.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

固定实轴点 x，考虑 g(z)=f(z)/(z−x)。

假设 f 在上半平面解析、边界足够正则，且满足所需衰减，使大圆弧积分趋零；还要求下面的主值存在。

仅有形式上的实虚部分解并不足以保证结论。

围道沿实轴从左到右，在 x 上方挖小半圆，再经大上半圆返回。

小弧令 z=x+εeit，t:π→0，于是 g(z)dz=if(x+εeit)dt，积分趋 −iπf(x)。

挖孔后的上半平面内部没有极点，围道积分为0。

令大半径趋无穷、小半径趋零，得到 PV∫−∞∞f(t)/(t−x)dt=iπf(x)。

写 f=u+iv，右侧 iπ(u+iv)=−πv+iπu。

比较实部得 PV∫u(t)/(t−x)dt=−πv(x)；比较虚部得 PV∫v(t)/(t−x)dt=πu(x)，分别除以 π 即为两条联系。

符号自检只需记住两件事：小上半圆是顺时针，所以先有 −iπf(x)；移到等式另一侧后变成 +iπf(x)。

若分母改写为 x−t，两条公式的符号也要一起改变。

Fix a real point x and consider g(z)=f(z)/(z−x).

Assume f is analytic above, sufficiently regular on the boundary, and decays enough for the large arc to vanish.

The principal values below must exist as well; a formal real-imaginary decomposition alone is insufficient.

Follow the real axis from left to right, indent above x, and return on the large upper semicircle.

On the small arc use z=x+εeit, t:π→0.

Then g(z)dz=if(x+εeit)dt, whose integral tends to −iπf(x).

After the indentation, there are no enclosed poles, so the contour integral is zero.

Let the large radius tend to infinity and the small one to zero to obtain PV∫−∞∞f(t)/(t−x)dt=iπf(x).

Write f=u+iv.

The right side is iπ(u+iv)=−πv+iπu.

Equating real parts gives PV∫u(t)/(t−x)dt=−πv(x), while imaginary parts give PV∫v(t)/(t−x)dt=πu(x).

Dividing by π yields the two relations.

For a sign check, the upper small arc is clockwise and contributes −iπf(x); moving it to the other side gives +iπf(x).

Replacing the denominator by x−t changes both formula signs.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

判断 f(z)=1/(z+i) 是否满足上半平面色散关系所需的解析性与衰减条件，并在 x=0 检查实部、虚部公式的符号。

Determine whether f(z)=1/(z+i) satisfies the analyticity and decay conditions for upper-half-plane dispersion relations, and check the signs of the real- and imaginary-part formulas at x=0.

已知什么Given

在实轴上写 f(x)=u(x)+iv(x)。采用 u(x)=1πPV∫−∞∞v(t)t−xdt 和 v(x)=−1πPV∫−∞∞u(t)t−xdt。

On the real axis, write f(x)=u(x)+iv(x). Use u(x)=1πPV∫−∞∞v(t)t−xdt and v(x)=−1πPV∫−∞∞u(t)t−xdt.

要求什么Find

先检查函数条件，再用 x=0 的直接积分核对两个符号。

Check the function conditions first, then verify both signs by direct integration at x=0.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1找出极点位置Locate the pole
    为什么这样做Why this step

    上半平面内不能有极点，否则不能直接使用该色散关系。

    The upper half-plane must contain no pole if this dispersion relation is to be used directly.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    f(z)=1/(z+i) 的唯一极点满足 z+i=0，即 z=−i，它位于下半平面。

    The only pole of f(z)=1/(z+i) satisfies z+i=0, so z=−i, which lies in the lower half-plane.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2检查无穷远衰减Check decay at infinity
    为什么这样做Why this step

    足够快的衰减能让闭合围道的大圆弧部分消失。

    Sufficient decay makes the large-arc contribution of the closed contour vanish.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    当 |z|→∞ 时，f(z)=O(1/z)；色散积分中的 f(z)/(z−x)=O(1/z2)。

    As |z|→∞, f(z)=O(1/z); the dispersion integrand satisfies f(z)/(z−x)=O(1/z2).

  3. 第 3 步Step 3分离实部和虚部Separate real and imaginary parts
    为什么这样做Why this step

    两个色散公式分别使用 u 与 v，所以先把它们显式写出。

    The two dispersion formulas use u and v separately, so first write them explicitly.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    f(x)=1x+i=x−ix2+1，故 u(x)=xx2+1、v(x)=−1x2+1。

    f(x)=1x+i=x−ix2+1, hence u(x)=xx2+1 and v(x)=−1x2+1.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4检查实部公式Check the real-part formula
    为什么这样做Why this step

    在 x=0 时，被积函数的奇偶性可以立刻给出主值。

    At x=0, parity immediately evaluates the principal value.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    1πPV∫−∞∞v(t)tdt=−1πPV∫−∞∞dtt(t2+1)=0=u(0)。

  5. 第 5 步Step 5检查虚部公式Check the imaginary-part formula
    为什么这样做Why this step

    第二式前面的负号必须通过实际代入确认。

    Direct substitution must confirm the minus sign in the second formula.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    −1πPV∫−∞∞u(t)tdt=−1π∫−∞∞dtt2+1=−1=v(0)。

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 极点 z=−i 不在上半平面，所以解析性条件满足。

    The pole z=−i is outside the upper half-plane, so the analyticity condition holds.

  • u(x) 是奇函数、v(x) 是偶函数，和分解结果一致。

    u(x) is odd and v(x) is even, matching the decomposition.

  • 在 x=0 得到 u(0)=0、v(0)=−1，两条公式的符号都吻合。

    At x=0, the results are u(0)=0 and v(0)=−1, so both formula signs agree.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

设 f(z)=1/(z+2i)，实轴边界值写作 f(x)=u(x)+iv(x)。先判断它是否在上半平面解析且充分衰减，再用 v(0)=−π−1PV∫−∞∞u(t)/tdt 验证虚部在原点的值。

Let f(z)=1/(z+2i), with real-axis boundary value f(x)=u(x)+iv(x). Check analyticity and sufficient decay in the upper half-plane, then verify the imaginary part at the origin using v(0)=−π−1PV∫−∞∞u(t)/tdt.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

先找极点：z=−2i 在下半平面。

Locate the pole first: z=−2i lies in the lower half-plane.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

有理化得到 u(t)=t/(t2+4)、v(t)=−2/(t2+4)。

Rationalizing gives u(t)=t/(t2+4) and v(t)=−2/(t2+4).

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

当 t≠0，u(t)/t=1/(t2+4)；这个商在原点可去，所以主值等于普通收敛积分。

For t≠0, u(t)/t=1/(t2+4); the quotient has a removable singularity at the origin, so its principal value equals an ordinary convergent integral.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    唯一极点是 z=−2i，因此上半平面和实轴附近均解析。

    The only pole is z=−2i, so the function is analytic in the upper half-plane and near the real axis.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    无穷远有 f(z)=O(1/|z|)，于是色散推导中 f(z)/z 的大弧积分消失；本题所需主值也存在。

    At infinity f(z)=O(1/|z|), making the large-arc integral of f(z)/z in the dispersion derivation vanish; the required principal value also exists.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    实轴上有 f(t)=(t−2i)/(t2+4)，故 u(t)=t/(t2+4)、v(t)=−2/(t2+4)。

    On the real axis f(t)=(t−2i)/(t2+4), hence u(t)=t/(t2+4) and v(t)=−2/(t2+4).

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    直接代入得到 v(0)=−1/2。

    Direct substitution gives v(0)=−1/2.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    在主值公式中，除去原点后 u(t)/t=1/(t2+4)。

    Away from the origin the principal-value integrand satisfies u(t)/t=1/(t2+4).

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    把原点补成有限值不会改变积分，且 ∫−∞∞dt/(t2+4)=π/2。

    Assigning its finite limiting value at the origin does not affect the integral, and ∫−∞∞dt/(t2+4)=π/2.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    因此公式右侧为 −π−1(π/2)=−1/2，与直接计算吻合。

    The formula therefore yields −π−1(π/2)=−1/2, agreeing with direct evaluation.

  8. 第 8 步Step 8

    这里保留主值记号以对应一般公式，但本题的表面奇点可以消去。

    The principal-value notation is retained to match the general formula, although the apparent singularity is removable here.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

符号核验：分母约定是 t−x，所以虚部公式带负号。相关课后题仅用于练习其中的有理实积分；不把它称作教材中的色散关系原题。

Sign check: with denominator t−x, the imaginary-part formula has a minus sign. The linked textbook exercise practices the rational real integral used here; this is not presented as a textbook dispersion-relation question.

正负号取决于解析半平面和核的方向；别只背 Hilbert 变换名称。

The signs depend on the analytic half-plane and the direction of the kernel. Learn those choices along with the Hilbert-transform name.

习题 1.1 · 1Exercise 1.1 · 1教材 p.7 / PDF p.16Textbook p.7 / PDF p.16

复数四则运算Arithmetic with complex numbers

计算实部与虚部：(1) (4+i)/(2−5i)；(2) (1+2i)/(3−4i)+(2+3i)/(5i)；(3) 5/[(1−i)(2−i)(3−i)]；(4) (1−i)4。

Find the real and imaginary parts: (1) (4+i)/(2−5i); (2) (1+2i)/(3−4i)+(2+3i)/(5i); (3) 5/[(1−i)(2−i)(3−i)]; (4) (1−i)4.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

把四个式子都化成 a+bi，再分别读出实部 a 和虚部 b。

Reduce all four expressions to a+bi, then read off the real part a and imaginary part b.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

分母含复数时乘共轭；连乘先分组；乘方可以反复平方。每次展开后都用 i2=−1。

Use a conjugate for complex denominators, group factors in products, and use repeated squaring for powers. Replace i2 by −1 after each expansion.

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(1)问上下同乘 2+5i，分母成为 (2−5i)(2+5i)=22+52=29。

    In part (1), multiply top and bottom by 2+5i: (2−5i)(2+5i)=22+52=29.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    展开分子：(4+i)(2+5i)=8+20i+2i+5i2=3+22i。

    Expand the numerator: (4+i)(2+5i)=8+20i+2i+5i2=3+22i.

    因此结果是 3/29+(22/29)i。

    The result is 3/29+(22/29)i.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(2)问第一项乘 3+4i：分子为 3+4i+6i+8i2=−5+10i，分母为 25，得到 (−1+2i)/5。

    For the first fraction in part (2), use 3+4i.

    The numerator is 3+4i+6i+8i2=−5+10i and the denominator is 25, giving (−1+2i)/5.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第二项用 1/i=−i：(2+3i)/(5i)=(3−2i)/5。

    For the second fraction, use 1/i=−i: (2+3i)/(5i)=(3−2i)/5.

    把实部相加、虚部相加，得到 2/5+0i。

    Add real and imaginary parts separately to obtain 2/5+0i.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(3)问先算 (1−i)(2−i)=2−3i+i2=1−3i，再算 (1−3i)(3−i)=3−10i+3i2=−10i。

    In part (3), first compute (1−i)(2−i)=2−3i+i2=1−3i, then (1−3i)(3−i)=3−10i+3i2=−10i.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    把第(3)问化成 5/(−10i)=(−1/2)(−i)=i/2；实部为零，虚部为 1/2。

    Reduce part (3) to 5/(−10i)=(−1/2)(−i)=i/2.

    Its real part is zero and imaginary part is 1/2.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(4)问算 (1−i)2=1−2i+i2=−2i，再平方得 (−2i)2=−4。

    For part (4), calculate (1−i)2=1−2i+i2=−2i, then (−2i)2=−4.

    最后检查：虚部是 i 的系数，答案中不能带 i。

    Final check: an imaginary part is the coefficient of i, so it does not itself contain i.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

若结果是 3/29+(22/29)i，它的虚部是多少？

If the result is 3/29+(22/29)i, what is its imaginary part?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

22/29；不是 22i/29。

22/29, without a factor of i.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

分母乘共轭；多个线性因子先相乘。

Multiply a denominator by its conjugate. If it has several linear factors, multiply those factors first.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

分母乘共轭；多个线性因子先相乘。

Multiply a denominator by its conjugate. If it has several linear factors, multiply those factors first.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

(1) 分子分母乘 2+5i，得到 (8+20i+2i−5)/29=(3+22i)/29。

(2) 第一项为 (−5+10i)/25=−1/5+2i/5；第二项为 (3−2i)/5，相加得 2/5。

(3) (1−i)(2−i)=1−3i，再乘 (3−i) 得 −10i，故结果为 i/2。

(4) (1−i)2=−2i，再平方为 −4。

(1) Multiply numerator and denominator by 2+5i to obtain (8+20i+2i−5)/29=(3+22i)/29.

(2) The first term is (−5+10i)/25=−1/5+2i/5 and the second is (3−2i)/5.

Their sum is 2/5.

(3) First (1−i)(2−i)=1−3i.

Multiplying by (3−i) gives −10i, so the result is i/2.

(4) First (1−i)2=−2i.

Squaring again gives −4.

最后答案Final answer

依次为 (3+22i)/29、2/5、i/2、−4。

In order: (3+22i)/29, 2/5, i/2, −4.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

分母实数化 → 合并实虚部 → 用模长粗验。

Make the denominator real → collect real and imaginary parts → check the size using moduli.

易错点

Common mistakes

i2=−1；1/i=−i。

习题 1.1 · 2Exercise 1.1 · 2教材 p.8 / PDF p.17Textbook p.8 / PDF p.17

模与辐角Modulus and argument

求模与辐角：(1) (1+i)/(2−23i)；(2) (1−i)3；(3) (1/5+2i/5)(3−i)；(4) (3−i)4。

Find the modulus and argument: (1) (1+i)/(2−23i); (2) (1−i)3; (3) (1/5+2i/5)(3−i); (4) (3−i)4.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

把每个复数拆成“长度”和“方向”，给出模、主辐角及全部辐角。

Find the modulus, principal argument, and all arguments by separating length from direction.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

对 x+iy，模为 x2+y2，角度必须符合所在象限。乘除、乘方再使用极形式。

For x+iy, use modulus x2+y2 and an angle in the correct quadrant. Then use polar form for products, quotients, and powers.

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(1)问：1+i 的模是 2、角是 π/4；2−23i 的模是 4+12=4、角是 −π/3。

    In part (1), 1+i has modulus 2 and angle π/4; 2−23i has modulus 4+12=4 and angle −π/3.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    除法把模相除、角相减：第(1)问得到 2/4 和 π/4−(−π/3)=7π/12。

    这个角在第二象限。

    Divide moduli and subtract angles: part (1) gives 2/4 and π/4−(−π/3)=7π/12, an angle in quadrant II.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(2)问写 1−i=2e−iπ/4。

    For part (2), write 1−i=2e−iπ/4.

    三次方使模变为 (2)3=22，角变为 3(−π/4)=−3π/4。

    Cubing gives modulus (2)3=22 and angle 3(−π/4)=−3π/4.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(3)问先乘开：(1+2i)(3−i)/5=(3−i+6i−2i2)/5=1+i。

    In part (3), expand first: (1+2i)(3−i)/5=(3−i+6i−2i2)/5=1+i.

    所以模为 2、主辐角为 π/4。

    Its modulus is 2 and principal argument is π/4.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(4)问写 3−i=2e−iπ/6。

    For part (4), write 3−i=2e−iπ/6.

    四次方给出模 24=16、角 4(−π/6)=−2π/3。

    The fourth power has modulus 24=16 and angle 4(−π/6)=−2π/3.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    以上四个角都已在 (−π,π] 内，故都是主辐角。

    All four angles already lie in (−π,π], so they are principal arguments.

    若要全部辐角，在各自的主辐角后加 2kπ，k∈Z。

    For all arguments, add 2kπ to each one, with k∈Z.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

负角度一定不符合主辐角的要求吗？

Is a negative angle necessarily invalid as a principal argument?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不是。主辐角取 (−π,π]，例如 −3π/4 就符合。

No. The interval is (−π,π], so −3π/4 is valid.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

乘除时模相乘相除、辐角相加相减；辐角写成主值加 2kπ。

Multiply or divide moduli, and add or subtract arguments. Write every argument as its principal value plus 2kπ.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

乘除时模相乘相除、辐角相加相减；辐角写成主值加 2kπ。

Multiply or divide moduli, and add or subtract arguments. Write every argument as its principal value plus 2kπ.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

(1) 分子模 2、角 π/4；分母模 4、角 −π/3。

所以模 2/4，角 7π/12+2kπ。

(2) 模 (2)3=22，角 −3π/4+2kπ。

(3) 乘开得 1+i，模 2，角 π/4+2kπ。

(4) 3−i=2e−iπ/6，四次方为 16e−2πi/3，模 16，角 −2π/3+2kπ。

(1) The numerator has modulus 2 and argument π/4.

The denominator has modulus 4 and argument −π/3.

Thus the quotient has modulus 2/4 and argument 7π/12+2kπ.

(2) The modulus is (2)3=22 and the argument is −3π/4+2kπ.

(3) Multiplication gives 1+i, with modulus 2 and argument π/4+2kπ.

(4) Write 3−i=2e−iπ/6.

Its fourth power is 16e−2πi/3, with modulus 16 and argument −2π/3+2kπ.

最后答案Final answer

模依次为 2/4,22,2,16；主辐角依次 7π/12,−3π/4,π/4,−2π/3。

The moduli are 2/4,22,2,16; the principal arguments are 7π/12,−3π/4,π/4,−2π/3.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

先分别求模、角，再合成，最后归入指定主值区间。

Find each modulus and angle → combine them → move the final angle into the requested principal range.

易错点

Common mistakes

反正切的数值不足以确定象限。

An arctangent value alone does not identify the quadrant.

复平面轨迹Loci in the complex plane

描述轨迹：(1) |z−3i|+|z+3i|=9；(2) |z−2+i|≤3；(3) 0<\arg[(z−i)/(z+i)]<π/4（取主辐角）。

Describe each locus: (1) |z−3i|+|z+3i|=9; (2) |z−2+i|≤3; (3) 0<\arg[(z−i)/(z+i)]<π/4, using the principal argument.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

把三个复数条件改写成可以直接画出的平面方程或不等式。

Rewrite the three complex conditions as plane equations or inequalities that can be drawn.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

模是到某点的距离。辐角限制先改写成实部、虚部的限制，再把分式实数化。

A modulus measures distance from a point. Turn an argument interval into inequalities for real and imaginary parts, then rationalize the quotient.

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(1)问把 3i 与 −3i 标为 (0,3) 与 (0,−3)。

    In part (1), mark 3i and −3i at (0,3) and (0,−3).

    到这两点的距离和为 9，所以是竖直长轴的椭圆。

    A distance sum of 9 gives an ellipse with a vertical major axis.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    椭圆满足 2a=9,c=3，故 a2=81/4、b2=a2−c2=45/4。

    Use 2a=9,c=3, so a2=81/4 and b2=a2−c2=45/4.

    把较大的分母放在竖直坐标下：x2/(45/4)+y2/(81/4)=1。

    Put the larger denominator under the vertical coordinate: x2/(45/4)+y2/(81/4)=1.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(2)问先改括号：|z−2+i|=|z−(2−i)|。

    For part (2), rewrite |z−2+i|=|z−(2−i)|.

    于是圆心是 (2,−1)、半径是 3；因为有 ≤，圆周与内部都要保留。

    The center is (2,−1) and radius is 3; the sign ≤ includes both boundary and interior.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第(3)问令 z=x+iy、w=(z−i)/(z+i)。

    For part (3), set z=x+iy and w=(z−i)/(z+i).

    分子分母同乘 x−i(y+1)，得到 w=[x2+y2−1−2ix]/[x2+(y+1)2]。

    Multiply top and bottom by x−i(y+1) to get w=[x2+y2−1−2ix]/[x2+(y+1)2].

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    角在 (0,π/4)，表示 w 在第一象限且低于斜率为1的直线，所以 0<Imw<Rew。

    An angle in (0,π/4) puts w in quadrant I below the line of slope one, so 0<Imw<Rew.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    分母为正时，两边同乘分母：0<−2x<x2+y2−1。

    Multiply by the positive denominator: 0<−2x<x2+y2−1.

    第一段给 x<0，第二段配方给 (x+1)2+y2>2。

    The first inequality gives x<0; completing the square in the second gives (x+1)2+y2>2.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    最后画左半平面与圆外部的交集，边界全部排除。

    Draw the intersection of the left half-plane and the exterior of the circle, excluding every boundary.

    核查 z=−i 会使分母为零、z=i 会使辐角无定义；它们都不满足最后的严格不等式。

    Check that z=−i makes the denominator zero and z=i makes the argument undefined; both are excluded by the final strict inequalities.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

为什么不能把 Imw<Rew 单独当作辐角条件？

Why is Imw<Rew alone insufficient?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

还必须有 Imw>0，才能限定到所需的第一象限区域。

We also need Imw>0 to select the required part of quadrant I.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

距离和对应椭圆；距离不等式对应圆盘；辐角不等式可先写出比值的实虚部。

A fixed sum of distances gives an ellipse. A distance inequality gives a disk. For an argument inequality, first find the quotient's real and imaginary parts.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

距离和对应椭圆；距离不等式对应圆盘；辐角不等式可先写出比值的实虚部。

A fixed sum of distances gives an ellipse. A distance inequality gives a disk. For an argument inequality, first find the quotient's real and imaginary parts.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

(1) 焦点 (0,±3)，长半轴 a=9/2，焦距参数 c=3，故短半轴平方 b2=a2−c2=45/4。

轨迹为 x2/(45/4)+y2/(81/4)=1。

(2) |z−(2−i)|≤3，是圆心 (2,−1)、半径 3 的闭圆盘。

(3) 写 z=x+iy，分母实数化：w=(z−i)/(z+i)=[x2+y2−1−2ix]/[x2+(y+1)2]。

角在 (0,π/4) 等价于 0<Imw<Rew，所以 x<0 且 x2+y2−1>−2x，即 (x+1)2+y2>2。

这些严格不等式自动排除 z=±i。

(1) The foci are (0,±3).

The semimajor axis is a=9/2 and the focal parameter is c=3, so the squared semiminor axis is b2=a2−c2=45/4.

The locus is x2/(45/4)+y2/(81/4)=1.

(2) Rewrite it as |z−(2−i)|≤3.

This is the closed disk with center (2,−1) and radius 3.

(3) Put z=x+iy and make the denominator real: w=(z−i)/(z+i)=[x2+y2−1−2ix]/[x2+(y+1)2].

An angle in (0,π/4) is equivalent to 0<Imw<Rew.

Thus x<0 and x2+y2−1>−2x, or (x+1)2+y2>2.

These strict inequalities automatically exclude z=±i.

最后答案Final answer

(1) 竖直长轴椭圆；(2) 闭圆盘；(3) x<0 且 (x+1)2+y2>2 的开区域。

(1) An ellipse with vertical major axis. (2) A closed disk. (3) The open region satisfying x<0 and (x+1)2+y2>2.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

把模解释成距离，把辐角解释成转角；复杂映射可转成实虚部不等式。

Read modulus as distance and argument as angle. For a complicated mapping, turn the condition into inequalities for real and imaginary parts.

易错点

Common mistakes

严格边界不能包含；比值为零或无定义时辐角无意义。

A strict inequality excludes its boundary. The argument is undefined when the quotient is zero or undefined.
